package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// CourseRepoPG implements CourseRepository.
type CourseRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

const coursePreviewSelectColumns = "c.id AS id, c.slug AS slug, COALESCE(ci.title, ci_fallback.title) AS title, COALESCE(ci.description, ci_fallback.description) AS description"

// Create inserts course.
func (r CourseRepoPG) Create(ctx context.Context, course domain.Course) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO course (id, slug, source_key, created_at, updated_at, main_tech_id, status, catalog_visible, lesson_read_access) VALUES ($1,$2,NULLIF($3,''),$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9)`,
		course.ID, course.Slug, course.SourceKey, course.CreatedAt, course.UpdatedAt, course.MainTechID, course.Status, course.CatalogVisible, course.LessonReadAccess)
	return err
}

// GetBySlug finds course by slug.
func (r CourseRepoPG) GetBySlug(ctx context.Context, slug string) (*domain.Course, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, slug, created_at, updated_at, main_tech_id, status, catalog_visible, lesson_read_access FROM course WHERE slug=$1`, slug)
	var c domain.Course
	if err := row.Scan(&c.ID, &c.Slug, &c.CreatedAt, &c.UpdatedAt, &c.MainTechID, &c.Status, &c.CatalogVisible, &c.LessonReadAccess); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &c, nil
}

// GetByID fetches course by id.
func (r CourseRepoPG) GetByID(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.Course, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, slug, created_at, updated_at, main_tech_id, status, catalog_visible, lesson_read_access FROM course WHERE id=$1`, id)
	var c domain.Course
	if err := row.Scan(&c.ID, &c.Slug, &c.CreatedAt, &c.UpdatedAt, &c.MainTechID, &c.Status, &c.CatalogVisible, &c.LessonReadAccess); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &c, nil
}

// Update updates course slug and main tech.
func (r CourseRepoPG) Update(ctx context.Context, course domain.Course) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE course SET slug=$1, main_tech_id=$2, status=$3, catalog_visible=$4, lesson_read_access=$5, updated_at=now() WHERE id=$6`,
		course.Slug, course.MainTechID, course.Status, course.CatalogVisible, course.LessonReadAccess, course.ID)
	return err
}

// Delete marks course as inactive.
func (r CourseRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, courseID string) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE course SET status=$1, updated_at=now() WHERE id=$2`, domain.CourseStatusNoActive, courseID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return err
}

// List returns localized course previews.
func (r CourseRepoPG) List(ctx context.Context, lang string, courseFilters filters.CourseFilters, sort *filters.SortOptions) ([]domain.CoursePreview, error) {
	query, args := r.buildListQuery(lang, coursePreviewSelectColumns, courseFilters, sort)

	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var res []domain.CoursePreview
	for rows.Next() {
		var c domain.CoursePreview
		if err := rows.Scan(&c.ID, &c.Slug, &c.Title, &c.Description); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		res = append(res, c)
	}
	return res, nil
}

// ListFields returns localized course previews with selected fields.
func (r CourseRepoPG) ListFields(ctx context.Context, lang string, f queryfields.Set, courseFilters filters.CourseFilters, sort *filters.SortOptions) ([]map[string]any, int, error) {
	selectCols := selectColumns(f, coursePreviewFieldSQL)
	if selectCols == "" {
		selectCols = coursePreviewSelectColumns
	}
	query, args := r.buildListQuery(lang, selectCols, courseFilters, sort)

	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var res []map[string]any
	for rows.Next() {
		row, err := ScanRowToMap(rows)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, 0, err
		}
		res = append(res, row)
	}

	total, err := r.countListTotal(ctx, lang, courseFilters)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, 0, err
	}

	return res, total, nil
}

func (r CourseRepoPG) countListTotal(ctx context.Context, lang string, courseFilters filters.CourseFilters) (int, error) {
	query, args := r.buildListCountQuery(lang, courseFilters)
	var total int
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	if err := runner.QueryRow(ctx, query, args...).Scan(&total); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return total, nil
}

// buildListQuery builds SQL query with filters, sorting, and pagination.
func (r CourseRepoPG) buildListQuery(lang string, selectCols string, courseFilters filters.CourseFilters, sort *filters.SortOptions) (string, []interface{}) {
	query, args, argIdx := r.buildListBaseQuery(lang, selectCols, courseFilters)

	// Build ORDER BY
	orderBy := "c.created_at DESC" // default
	if courseFilters.CatalogOrdered {
		orderBy = `catalog_path.track_order ASC NULLS LAST,
			catalog_path.track_key ASC,
			catalog_path.level_order ASC,
			catalog_path.level_key ASC,
			catalog_path.group_order ASC,
			catalog_path.group_key ASC,
			catalog_path.course_order ASC,
			c.id ASC`
	} else if sort != nil {
		switch sort.Field {
		case filters.SortFieldCreatedAt:
			orderBy = fmt.Sprintf("c.created_at %s", strings.ToUpper(string(sort.Order)))
		case filters.SortFieldUpdatedAt:
			orderBy = fmt.Sprintf("c.updated_at %s", strings.ToUpper(string(sort.Order)))
		case filters.SortFieldTitle:
			orderBy = fmt.Sprintf("COALESCE(ci.title, ci_fallback.title) %s", strings.ToUpper(string(sort.Order)))
		}
	}
	query += " ORDER BY " + orderBy

	_, limit, offset := filters.NormalizePagination(courseFilters.Page, courseFilters.Limit)
	query += fmt.Sprintf(" LIMIT $%d OFFSET $%d", argIdx, argIdx+1)
	args = append(args, limit, offset)

	return query, args
}

func (r CourseRepoPG) buildListCountQuery(lang string, courseFilters filters.CourseFilters) (string, []interface{}) {
	query, args, _ := r.buildListBaseQuery(lang, "COUNT(*)", courseFilters)
	return query, args
}

// buildListBaseQuery builds SQL query with joins and filters, without ordering or pagination.
func (r CourseRepoPG) buildListBaseQuery(lang string, selectCols string, courseFilters filters.CourseFilters) (string, []interface{}, int) {
	var args []interface{}
	argIdx := 1

	if selectCols == "" {
		selectCols = coursePreviewSelectColumns
	}

	query := fmt.Sprintf(`
WITH lang AS (
    SELECT id FROM i18n WHERE language = $%d
)
SELECT %s
FROM course c
LEFT JOIN lang l ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN course_i18n ci ON ci.course_id = c.id AND l.id = ci.i18n_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ci2.title, ci2.description
    FROM course_i18n ci2
    WHERE ci2.course_id = c.id
    ORDER BY ci2.i18n_id
    LIMIT 1
) ci_fallback ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', t.id, 'slug', t.slug, 'name', t.name) ORDER BY t.name) AS tags
    FROM course_tag ct
    JOIN tag t ON t.id = ct.tag_id
    WHERE ct.course_id = c.id
) course_tags ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        jsonb_agg(ct.tech_id ORDER BY ct.tech_id) AS tech_ids,
        jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', t.id, 'label', t.label) ORDER BY t.label) AS techs
    FROM course_tech ct
    JOIN tech t ON t.id = ct.tech_id
    WHERE ct.course_id = c.id
) course_techs ON TRUE
	LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
	    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lsn.id)::int AS lesson_count
	    FROM course_module cm
	    JOIN module_section ms ON ms.module_id = cm.module_id
	    JOIN section_lesson sl ON sl.section_id = ms.section_id
	    JOIN lesson lsn ON lsn.id = sl.lesson_id
	    WHERE cm.course_id = c.id
	) course_lessons ON TRUE
`, argIdx, selectCols)
	args = append(args, lang)
	argIdx++

	if courseFilters.CatalogOrdered {
		catalogPathConditions := []string{"cgc.course_id = c.id", "cgc.status = 1"}
		if courseFilters.TrackSlug != nil {
			catalogPathConditions = append(catalogPathConditions, fmt.Sprintf("t.slug = $%d", argIdx))
			args = append(args, *courseFilters.TrackSlug)
			argIdx++
		}
		if courseFilters.LevelSlug != nil {
			catalogPathConditions = append(catalogPathConditions, fmt.Sprintf("cl.slug = $%d", argIdx))
			args = append(args, *courseFilters.LevelSlug)
			argIdx++
		}
		query += fmt.Sprintf(`
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        t."order" AS track_order,
        COALESCE(t.source_key, t.id::text) AS track_key,
        tl."order" AS level_order,
        COALESCE(cl.source_key, cl.id::text) AS level_key,
        lcg."order" AS group_order,
        COALESCE(cg.source_key, cg.id::text) AS group_key,
        cgc."order" AS course_order
    FROM course_group_course cgc
    JOIN course_group cg ON cg.id = cgc.group_id AND cg.status = 1
    JOIN level_course_group lcg ON lcg.group_id = cg.id AND lcg.status = 1
    JOIN course_level cl ON cl.id = lcg.level_id AND cl.status = 1
    JOIN track_level tl ON tl.level_id = cl.id AND tl.status = 1
    JOIN track t ON t.id = tl.track_id AND t.status = 1
    WHERE %s
    ORDER BY
        t."order" ASC NULLS LAST,
        COALESCE(t.source_key, t.id::text) ASC,
        tl."order" ASC,
        COALESCE(cl.source_key, cl.id::text) ASC,
        lcg."order" ASC,
        COALESCE(cg.source_key, cg.id::text) ASC,
        cgc."order" ASC,
        cgc.group_id ASC
    LIMIT 1
) catalog_path ON TRUE
`, strings.Join(catalogPathConditions, " AND "))
	}

	// Build WHERE conditions
	var whereConditions []string
	if courseFilters.ID != nil {
		whereConditions = append(whereConditions, fmt.Sprintf("c.id = $%d", argIdx))
		args = append(args, *courseFilters.ID)
		argIdx++
	}
	if courseFilters.Slug != nil {
		whereConditions = append(whereConditions, fmt.Sprintf("c.slug = $%d", argIdx))
		args = append(args, *courseFilters.Slug)
		argIdx++
	}
	if courseFilters.Status != nil {
		whereConditions = append(whereConditions, fmt.Sprintf("c.status = $%d", argIdx))
		args = append(args, *courseFilters.Status)
		argIdx++
	}
	if courseFilters.CatalogVisible != nil {
		whereConditions = append(whereConditions, fmt.Sprintf("c.catalog_visible = $%d", argIdx))
		args = append(args, *courseFilters.CatalogVisible)
		argIdx++
	}
	if courseFilters.Title != nil {
		whereConditions = append(whereConditions, fmt.Sprintf("(COALESCE(ci.title, ci_fallback.title) ILIKE $%d)", argIdx))
		args = append(args, "%"+*courseFilters.Title+"%")
		argIdx++
	}
	if courseFilters.TagID != nil {
		whereConditions = append(whereConditions, fmt.Sprintf("EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM course_tag ct WHERE ct.course_id = c.id AND ct.tag_id = $%d)", argIdx))
		args = append(args, *courseFilters.TagID)
		argIdx++
	}
	if courseFilters.TagSlug != nil {
		whereConditions = append(whereConditions, fmt.Sprintf("EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM course_tag ct JOIN tag t ON t.id = ct.tag_id WHERE ct.course_id = c.id AND t.slug = $%d)", argIdx))
		args = append(args, *courseFilters.TagSlug)
		argIdx++
	}
	if courseFilters.CourseGroupID != nil {
		activeClause := ""
		groupJoin := ""
		if courseFilters.CatalogActiveOnly {
			groupJoin = " JOIN course_group cg ON cg.id = cgc.group_id"
			activeClause = " AND cgc.status = 1 AND cg.status = 1"
		}
		whereConditions = append(whereConditions, fmt.Sprintf("EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM course_group_course cgc%s WHERE cgc.course_id = c.id AND cgc.group_id = $%d%s)", groupJoin, argIdx, activeClause))
		args = append(args, *courseFilters.CourseGroupID)
		argIdx++
	}
	if courseFilters.LevelID != nil {
		activeJoins := ""
		activeClause := ""
		if courseFilters.CatalogActiveOnly {
			activeJoins = `
			JOIN course_group cg ON cg.id = cgc.group_id
			JOIN course_level cl ON cl.id = lcg.level_id`
			activeClause = " AND cgc.status = 1 AND lcg.status = 1 AND cg.status = 1 AND cl.status = 1"
		}
		whereConditions = append(whereConditions, fmt.Sprintf(`EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM course_group_course cgc
			JOIN level_course_group lcg ON lcg.group_id = cgc.group_id
			%s
			WHERE cgc.course_id = c.id AND lcg.level_id = $%d%s
		)`, activeJoins, argIdx, activeClause))
		args = append(args, *courseFilters.LevelID)
		argIdx++
	}
	if courseFilters.TrackID != nil {
		activeJoins := ""
		activeClause := ""
		if courseFilters.CatalogActiveOnly {
			activeJoins = `
			JOIN course_group cg ON cg.id = cgc.group_id
			JOIN course_level cl ON cl.id = lcg.level_id
			JOIN track t ON t.id = tl.track_id`
			activeClause = " AND cgc.status = 1 AND lcg.status = 1 AND tl.status = 1 AND cg.status = 1 AND cl.status = 1 AND t.status = 1"
		}
		whereConditions = append(whereConditions, fmt.Sprintf(`EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM course_group_course cgc
			JOIN level_course_group lcg ON lcg.group_id = cgc.group_id
			JOIN track_level tl ON tl.level_id = lcg.level_id
			%s
			WHERE cgc.course_id = c.id AND tl.track_id = $%d%s
		)`, activeJoins, argIdx, activeClause))
		args = append(args, *courseFilters.TrackID)
		argIdx++
	}
	if !courseFilters.CatalogOrdered && courseFilters.TrackSlug != nil && courseFilters.LevelSlug != nil {
		whereConditions = append(whereConditions, fmt.Sprintf(`EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM course_group_course cgc
			JOIN course_group cg ON cg.id = cgc.group_id
			JOIN level_course_group lcg ON lcg.group_id = cg.id
			JOIN course_level cl ON cl.id = lcg.level_id
			JOIN track_level tl ON tl.level_id = cl.id
			JOIN track t ON t.id = tl.track_id
			WHERE cgc.course_id = c.id
				AND t.slug = $%d
				AND cl.slug = $%d
				AND cgc.status = 1
				AND cg.status = 1
				AND lcg.status = 1
				AND cl.status = 1
				AND tl.status = 1
				AND t.status = 1
		)`, argIdx, argIdx+1))
		args = append(args, *courseFilters.TrackSlug, *courseFilters.LevelSlug)
		argIdx += 2
	}

	if len(whereConditions) > 0 {
		query += " WHERE " + strings.Join(whereConditions, " AND ")
	}

	return query, args, argIdx
}

// GetByIDWithFields returns course with selected fields.
func (r CourseRepoPG) GetByIDWithFields(ctx context.Context, id string, f queryfields.Set) (map[string]any, error) {
	cols := columnsWithAliases(f, courseFieldSQL)
	if len(cols) == 0 {
		cols = []string{
			"c.id AS id",
			"c.slug AS slug",
			"c.created_at AS created_at",
			"c.updated_at AS updated_at",
			"c.main_tech_id AS main_tech_id",
			"c.status AS status",
			"c.catalog_visible AS catalog_visible",
		}
	}
	selectCols := strings.Join(cols, ", ")

	query := fmt.Sprintf(`SELECT %s
FROM course c
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ci2.title, ci2.description
    FROM course_i18n ci2
    WHERE ci2.course_id = c.id
    ORDER BY ci2.i18n_id
    LIMIT 1
) ci_fallback ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', t.id, 'slug', t.slug, 'name', t.name) ORDER BY t.name) AS tags
    FROM course_tag ct
    JOIN tag t ON t.id = ct.tag_id
    WHERE ct.course_id = c.id
) course_tags ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        jsonb_agg(ct.tech_id ORDER BY ct.tech_id) AS tech_ids,
        jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', t.id, 'label', t.label) ORDER BY t.label) AS techs
    FROM course_tech ct
    JOIN tech t ON t.id = ct.tech_id
    WHERE ct.course_id = c.id
) course_techs ON TRUE
	LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
	    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lsn.id)::int AS lesson_count
	    FROM course_module cm
	    JOIN module_section ms ON ms.module_id = cm.module_id
	    JOIN section_lesson sl ON sl.section_id = ms.section_id
	    JOIN lesson lsn ON lsn.id = sl.lesson_id
	    WHERE cm.course_id = c.id
	) course_lessons ON TRUE
WHERE c.id=$1`, selectCols)

	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, query, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	if !rows.Next() {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}

	return ScanRowToMap(rows)
}

// Ensure interfaces.
var _ repository.CourseRepository = (*CourseRepoPG)(nil)
